video_title: 18 questions you've always wanted to ask a Philadelphia 76ers player! | V.J. Edgecombe NBA Unpacked

quotes.speaker: V.J. Edgecombe
quotes.summary_phrase: V.J. Edgecombe on the uncertainty of waiting to be drafted
quotes.excerpt: I didn't know until a minute before they call my name.
quotes.quote: When the draft starts, your agent or whoever you got at your table, whoever they're contacting at the table, is going to let you know. I didn't know until a minute before they call my name. And then my mom gave it away because she started crying. So my mom gave it away because she started crying. But that's how you know that.

quotes.speaker: V.J. Edgecombe
quotes.summary_phrase: V.J. Edgecombe on the physical toll of back-to-back games
quotes.excerpt: It is extremely difficult, especially when you got to travel.
quotes.quote: It is extremely difficult, especially when you got to travel. But your body kind of get used to it. My first back-to-back, I was exhausted. I was sleeping in the locker room before the game. That was not a good sign. I only shot threes on the second of the back-to-back for some reason. But now I'm better. I got better now.

quotes.speaker: V.J. Edgecombe
quotes.summary_phrase: V.J. Edgecombe on players checking stats on the jumbotron
quotes.excerpt: Some arenas have your stats up on the jumbotron, and that's how you see.
quotes.quote: Some arenas have your stats up on the jumbotron, and that's how you see. So I'm assuming everyone check their stats up there. But during time outs on the paper or anything, no.

quotes.speaker: V.J. Edgecombe
quotes.summary_phrase: V.J. Edgecombe on getting starstruck by courtside celebrities
quotes.excerpt: I was kind of like that when I first seen Jay-Z.
quotes.quote: I was kind of like that when I first seen Jay-Z. I seen Jay-Z courtside. I was like, oh, I keep telling my team, I'm like, that's Jay-Z, yo. It's so crazy. I don't even listen to his music for real, but it's Jay-Z. So it's like maybe Beyoncé might walk in, who knows, you know what I'm saying? So yeah, that's why I was a little starstruck.

quotes.speaker: V.J. Edgecombe
quotes.summary_phrase: V.J. Edgecombe's list of must-watch NBA players
quotes.excerpt: For the past, Jordan, Kobe, fundamentals and everything, Tim Duncan, Shaq, Brandon Roy.
quotes.quote: For the past, Jordan, Kobe, fundamentals and everything, Tim Duncan, Shaq, Brandon Roy. Someone I feel like it's really nice is Brandon Roy. And then present, LeBron James, obviously, Steph Curry, don't think you can do what they're doing, but yeah, Steph Curry, 2023 Joel Embiid, hell yeah, Kyrie Irving, I don't watch him, I was say, it's crazy, it's five, only five, Kevin Durant.

quotes.speaker: V.J. Edgecombe
quotes.summary_phrase: V.J. Edgecombe on the process of choosing a jersey number
quotes.excerpt: Obviously you have a preferred number that you might want, but either it might be retired.
quotes.quote: Obviously you have a preferred number that you might want, but either it might be retired or unavailable at the time. So you still kind of get to choose it. You kind of get to choose another number off a list of all available numbers. And most of the numbers be nasty. So it's like, yeah.

quotes.speaker: V.J. Edgecombe
quotes.summary_phrase: V.J. Edgecombe on the inspiration behind his jersey number
quotes.excerpt: I wanted 7. I only wanted 17. But Kyle Lowry had it.
quotes.quote: I wanted 7. I only wanted 17. But Kyle Lowry had it and obviously he's a legend and a Hall of Famer. So I was like, I can't do that. Just out of respect for the game and respect for him, I won't ask for it. So I was going to wait until he retired. And then Jaylen Brown came in. So then it's like, all right, bro, it's cool. So I'll just rock 77 for the rest of my life.
